cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 70% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.55% · WTI -3.74% · Brent +1.03% · NatGas -5.97%. 70% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +3.75%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Shale & E&P lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +3.75%; weakest is Shale & E&P at -0.39%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: BE is the standout at +7.73%
cards.body: Leaders: BE +7.73%, WFRD +7.32%, CEG +4.93%, VST +4.90%, VRT +4.75%. Laggards: EQT -1.65%, ENPH -1.23%, LEU -1.08%, EOSE -0.89%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
